text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> se-sre-oncall for service="inference-az4" severity=high. Symptom: sudden spike in prefix-cache evictions and 500-level errors from model shard pods. PD link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-12345 :rotating_light:

Sarah H: acked. I'm on it, will triage metrics/logs now.

Mike T: seeing 5xx rate jump ~08:42 UTC across az4 frontend + model-proxy. Error pattern: KV cache misses + OOM eviction churn on worker-3. Sample error lines below:

Mike T: ```
2026-03-14T08:41:12Z worker-3 inference[pid=2231]: kv_cache: eviction_count=1278 tail_latency_ms=2.1
2026-03-14T08:41:12Z worker-3 inference[pid=2231]: runtime: OOM while growing KV cache, evicted 1024 entries
2026-03-14T08:41:13Z gateway-az4 proxy[pid=412]: upstream "model-shard-7" 502 after 1000ms
```

Lina R: confirmed error spike on dashboards (latency p95 -> 1.2s, 5xx went from 0.3% -> 9%). Affected routes: /v1/generate and streaming sockets. Some customer-reported degraded responses.

Sarah H: quick mitigation plan: 1) engage routing fallback to route new sessions away from az4 to az2/us-west as capacity allows, 2) temporarily enable degraded-mode quantization on az4 to reduce mem pressure, 3) scale up dedicated pool in az4 if capacity is available, 4) prepare canary failover if routing doesn't stabilize. Executing step 1 now.

Remy C: noted. On it for routing switch. Command I ran (k8s control plane):

Remy C: ```sh
# set routing weight for inference-az4 -> 0.2 (reduce traffic)
kubectl -n routing patch configmap inference-routing -p '{"data": {"az4_weight": "0.2"}}'
# trigger config reload
kubectl -n routing rollout restart deploy/routing-proxy
```

Mike T: running quick health probes against model shards in az4: `curl -sS -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null http://model-shard-7.health/ready` -> 503/504 intermittently. Also seeing KV eviction metrics per-pod: worker-1: 300/s, worker-3: 1200/s.

pagerduty: Incident PD-12345 acknowledged by Sarah H (se-sre-oncall).

Sarah H: starting degraded quantization toggle on az4 (api flag flip). If that drops memory pressure we'll keep traffic routed; otherwise handoff to full failover.

Josh D: FYI customer-impact check: customer-facing errors being reported by 2 enterprise tenants (eu-west orgs). Opening interim status page note (internal): "Investigating elevated errors in az4; rerouting in progress."

Remy C: routing change propagated, incoming new sessions to az4 dropped ~70% within 30s. Observed total 5xx rate across system dropped from 8.7% -> 3.1% after routing change.

Sarah H: degraded quantization applied. Memory pressure on worker-3 dropped ~40%, eviction_count rate trending down. Still seeing occasional 5xx from long-lived sessions.

Lina R: preparing handoff. I'll take next 2-hour watch for follow-ups + customer comms. Items for handover: 1) confirm sustained drop in evictions for 10m, 2) validate model correctness under quantized mode with smoke prompts, 3) coordinate with infra to scale pool if new evictions appear, 4) synth traffic for long-lived sessions.

pagerduty: Automated escalation scheduled in 5m to infra-ops if not resolved.

Sarah H: leaving the channel, handoff -> Lina R. Tagging @Lina_R for visibility. :wave:

Lina R: acked. Taking over. Running smoke test now.

Lina R: smoke test results: generation latency ok, outputs consistent on sample prompts, error rate on az4 backend now 0.9% (from 8.7%). I'll keep routing weight at current reduced level while we monitor.

Remy C: noted and documenting runbook steps executed in incident ticket. Added links to executed commands and metric snapshots.

Lina R: customer outreach: sent short note to affected orgs that we're mitigating and rerouting traffic; asked for logs if they keep seeing failures.

pagerduty: PD-12345 status updated -> acknowledged -> assigned to Lina R.

incident-bot: autopager check: infra-ops not paged; escalation timer reset after routing success.

Lina R: plan to gradually restore az4 weighting after two 10m stable windows, validate no evictions spike. If evictions recur, we'll flip full failover (route all new sessions off az4) and schedule controlled scale+restart of worker-3.

Remy C: creating follow-up ticket for infra to investigate root cause (KV cache sizing + mem leak hypothesis).

Lina R: marking channel as monitored. Will update again when we either restore or escalate.

pagerduty: PD-12345 resolved by Lina R (resolution: routing fallback + degraded quantization stabilized mem pressure; follow-up ticket INF-456 created).

Lina R: closing note: postmortem to follow if we see recurrence. Good catch on the autopage system, routing fallback worked as intended. :white_check_mark:"
